mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months with a positive PAYEMS month-over-month change.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and stable consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.5%) indicates a favorable monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase (GDPC1 annual growth > 2%), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months during the post-recession recovery phase when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where INDPRO is below 90.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising retail sales (RSAFS) and increasing housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer spending and housing market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it signals a tightening labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where UNRATE is below 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0%), a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL below 1.5%) signals that the Fed's policy is not overly restrictive, supporting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months during monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) when CPIAUCSL is below 1.5%.
